metadata.title: Fixed point properties and cohomology of Banach representations of arithmetic groups
metadata.abstract: We study fixed point theorems for actions of lattices of semisimple groups. They are deduced from vanishing results for the group cohomology of $L^p$-representations. We show that for lattices in simple groups of higher rank, the cohomology with $L^p$-coefficients vanishes below the rank whenever there are no invariant vectors. As a corollary of the vanishing for $L^1$-coefficients, we obtain that every action on an acyclic simplicial complex of dimension lower than the rank has a finite orbit. This in particular proves a conjecture by Farb. The $L^p$-vanishing below the rank proves a conjecture by Gromov regarding $L^p$-cohomology of symmetric spaces.
